map.目标浓度按纯元素计；养分含量为肥料质量百分比。: Target concentration is by pure element; nutrient content is the fertilizer mass percentage.
map.纯养分(kg) = 总灌水量(m³) × 目标浓度(mg/L) ÷ 1000；肥: Pure nutrient (kg) = total irrigation (m³) x target concentration (mg/L) / 1000; commercial fertilizer (kg) = pure nutrient / (nutrient content / 100)
map.根据灌溉面积、灌水量、目标养分浓度和肥料含量，计算肥料用量与母液配比。: From irrigation area, water volume, target nutrient concentration, and fertilizer content, compute fertilizer amount and stock-solution ratio.
map.纯养分需求量（kg）= 总灌水量（m³）× 目标浓度（mg/L）÷ 1000: Pure nutrient demand (kg) = total irrigation (m³) x target concentration (mg/L) / 1000
map.肥料商品用量（kg）= 纯养分需求量 ÷（养分含量 ÷ 100）: Commercial fertilizer amount (kg) = pure nutrient demand / (nutrient content / 100)
map.本工具按单一养分计算，复合肥请按主养分折算后分次使用: This tool computes one nutrient; for compound fertilizer, convert by main nutrient and apply in splits.
map.按目标 EC 计算母液倍数：田间 EC = 母液 EC / 稀释倍数。: Compute stock dilution from target EC: field EC = stock EC / dilution factor.
map.依作物不同生育期调节 N-P-K 比例与浓度。: Adjust N-P-K ratio and concentration by crop growth stage.
map.用于番茄、黄瓜等设施蔬菜的精准灌溉施肥。: For precise fertigation of greenhouse vegetables like tomato and cucumber.
map.目标 EC 2.0 mS/cm，母液 EC 20 mS/cm，则稀释倍数 = 2: Target EC 2.0 mS/cm, stock EC 20 mS/cm, dilution = 20/2.0 = 10x, i.e. 1 part stock to 9 parts water. N-P-K 1.2:0.4:1.6 meets potassium need for swelling.
map.EC 和 pH 先调哪个？: Which to adjust first, EC or pH?
map.先调 pH 到 5.5~6.5（多数作物适宜区间），再校 EC。pH 偏差会影响: First adjust pH to 5.5-6.5 (suitable for most crops), then calibrate EC. pH deviation affects nutrient availability, especially Fe, Mn, P fixing in alkaline conditions.
map.母液能混配所有肥料吗？: Can the stock mix all fertilizers?
map.不能。钙肥与硫酸盐/磷酸盐同罐易沉淀，应分罐或错时注入。混配前做少量相容性试验，: No. Calcium with sulfate/phosphate in one tank precipitates easily; use separate tanks or staggered injection. Do a small compatibility test before mixing to avoid clogging.
map.面向水肥一体化系统，快速把目标施肥浓度转换为肥料用量与母液配比。: For fertigation systems, quickly convert target fertilization concentration into fertilizer amount and stock ratio.
